flowable:taskListener.flowable:script:
def taskId = task.id def taskName = task.name def priority = task.priority def assignee = task.assignee ?: "Unassigned"
def payload = '{"id":"' + taskId + '","name":"' + taskName + '","priority":' + priority + ',"assignee":"' + assignee + '"}'
def url = new URL('http://host.docker.internal:5001/task-created') def connection = url.openConnection()
connection.setRequestMethod('POST') connection.setDoOutput(true) connection.setRequestProperty('Content-Type', 'application/json')
connection.getOutputStream().write(payload.getBytes('UTF-8'))
println 'TASK_CREATED: ' + taskId println 'AI webhook response code: ' + connection.getResponseCode() println 'AI webhook response: ' + connection.getInputStream().getText('UTF-8')
